The vulnerability AD CS is a Microsoft Windows Server role that lets an organization run its own Public Key Infrastructure (PKI). title: ChatGPT joins the most impersonated brands in phishing attacks
summary: Microsoft continued to be the most impersonated brand in Q2 2026, accounting for 23% of all brand phishing attempts. LinkedIn, Google, Apple, and Amazon followed, with the five brands together making up more than half of all brand phishing attempts tracked during the quarter, according to Check Point’s Q2 2026 Brand Phishing Report.
